title: King Edward Medical University Lahore Amendment Ordinance 2021

sections.shortTitle: King Edward Medical University Lahore Amendment Ordinance 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 182
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 182
ORDINANCE II OF 2021
KING EDWARD MEDICAL UNIVERSITY, LAHORE (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the King Edward Medical
University,
Lahore Act 2005 (V of 2005)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
14th January, 2021]
No.
Legis: 13-29/2004 (P-II), dated 14.1.2021.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:
. It is
necessary to amend the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act 2005 (V of
2005) to incorporate certain provisions for smooth implementation of the Act
and other relevant laws.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session, and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:,
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the King Edward Medical University, Lahore
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2021.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

(a) in

(b) after

clause (x), for the word "University", the words "King Edward

Legis: 13-29/2004 (P-II), dated 14.1.2021.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:
. It is
necessary to amend the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act 2005 (V of
2005) to incorporate certain provisions for smooth implementation of the Act
and other relevant laws.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session, and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:,
4. Amendment
of section 3 of Act V of 2005.---In
the Act, in section 3:
(a) in
subsection (1), the expression ", by reconstituting the King Edward
Medical College, Lahore" shall be omitted;
(b) for
subsection (5), the following shall be substituted:
"(5)
All properties, rights and interests of whatever kind, used, enjoyed,
possessed, owned or vested in or held in trust by or for the University, and
all liabilities legally subsisting against the University, which had been
transferred from King Edward Medical College, Lahore, to the University
pursuant to reconstitution of the University shall stand transferred to King
Edward Medical College, Lahore.".
(c) after
subsection (5), the following subsection (6) shall be added:
"(6) The existing
faculty and staff of the University who are employees of the Government, shall
become the faculty and staff of King Edward Medical College, Lahore, and the
employees of the University serving King Edward Medical College, Lahore, shall
continue to be the employees of the University.".

5. Amendment
of section 5 of Act V of 2005.---In
the Act, for section 5, the following shall be substituted:
"5.
Jurisdiction.---(1) The University shall exercise the powers conferred on
it by or under this Act within its jurisdiction and in respect of its
constituent colleges.
(2) The King
Edward Medical College, Lahore shall exercise teaching jurisdiction in relation
to the attached hospitals, and the hospitals so attached under clause (x) of
section 2 shall be under the administrative control of the Government.".
